resolved_conflicts.explanation: The record calls it a replica lookout. Recreation.gov and the Forest Service describe a replica of a lookout design built for rent. cherylhill.net says it was never used as a lookout and leaves it off its standing-lookout list. The story reports both views.

notes_for_editor: Build facts agree across Recreation.gov and the Forest Service. The replica label holds, but cherylhill.net says the cabin was never used as a lookout, so it is a rental in lookout form, not a fire-watch site. Access was unknown in the record; Recreation.gov shows a public reservation rental, so it is recorded as public. A third-party listing gives a $10 nightly fee; it is not in the story because the Recreation.gov fee text was not retrieved. The record's firelookout.org status (standing) is confirmed.
